notes: Card: ' investment' x6, ' gold' x3 in commodities and fund text. Probes: gold prices 0.51, stock holdings 0.56, 'other investment' (disclaimer) 0.60, dividend income portfolios 0.38; 'gold necklace' 0.06, 'big investment in youth coaching' 0.005. Near misses keep the same words outside finance.
